workflow_runs.display_title: fix(tui): keep the chat tail anchored when the thinking block is focused

head_commit.message:
fix(tui): keep the chat tail anchored when the thinking block is focused

Focusing or clicking the expanded reasoning block used Widget.focus()'s
default scroll_visible=True, which centred the tall block and released the
ChatArea tail anchor. The viewport jumped up off the streaming answer and
never scrolled back, so the model's reply was off-screen.

Route the box/click focus paths through focus(scroll_visible=False) and
re-arm the chat tail in ThoughtBlock._watch_collapsed after a toggle.
Add a deterministic regression test that fails without the fix.
